conclusion: Supported: The MISEV2023 guidance (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports requiring an orthogonal EV characterization and transparent production reporting prior to advancing intranasal EV formulation and cross-species bridging studies. Unsupported: Program-specific assertions about the presence or absence of MCB/WCB, validated orthogonal QC assays (including intact-EV assay LLOQ/specificity/precision), GMP-like batch reports, stability-indicating potency correlated to in vivo PD, and formulation/device compatibility recovery data cannot be verified from the supplied evidence set because no program-specific CMC, analytic validation, batch, stability, or biodistribution reports are included.
unsupported_assertions: Any program-level claim that MCB/WCB generation and characterization reports exist (or do not exist) cannot be verified from the supplied evidence.
Any program-level claim that validated orthogonal QC assays (including intact-EV assay performance: LLOQ, specificity, precision) have been completed cannot be verified from the supplied evidence.
Any program-level claim that >=3 GMP-like batch reports demonstrating release and batch-to-batch reproducibility are available cannot be verified from the supplied evidence.
Any program-level claim that stability and stability-indicating potency assay data correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint exist cannot be verified from the supplied evidence.

Any program-level claim that formulation/device compatibility recovery data and controlled large-animal intranasal biodistribution with orthogonal controls are available cannot be verified from the supplied evidence.
